prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: The STL decomposition reveals a strongly upward trending series (both folds show 'up' direction). While 13 models tie at perfect trend correlation (1.0), CWT_rf emerges as overall champion with lowest RMSE (129.48). FT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.5239 correlation), creating a split champion scenario. High model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=76.64) and concept drift detected suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition-aware combination while handling drift through dynamic weighting.
